proposed_statement_changes.reason: The coverage event implies unconditional familywise control for the rule that reports only when \(\mathcal D_n\ne\varnothing\). It does not imply the literal conditional bound \(\Pr\{\text{false compulsion}\mid\mathcal D_n\ne\varnothing\}\le\eta\), because conditioning would divide by an uncontrolled probability. The proposed claim states exactly the valid guarantee.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Constructing an exact enumerator for \(\mathcal D_n\) with delay polynomial in the input bit length and \(d\), together with polynomially checkable inclusion or exclusion certificates for every labeled DAG.
open_obligations.obstruction: The source-forest theorem is pointwise in a realizable coefficient vector, whereas \(C_n\) ranges over vectors whose skeleton and head signatures can change. Exact membership of one graph is an existential nonlinear feasibility problem with strict parameter inequalities and with \(\epsilon_n=\sqrt{\log(2|I_4|/\eta)/(2n)}\). The frozen core supplies neither a polynomial-time feasibility oracle nor a complexity lower bound, so a polynomial-delay conclusion cannot be derived honestly.
open_obligations.attempted: Reduce membership graph by graph using the reverse-topological decoder, interval screening, and source-forest enumeration. The decoder is decisive at a fixed realizable vector, but interval screening is not complete when coefficient signs can cross zero inside \(C_n\), and exhaustive graph enumeration has no polynomial-delay guarantee. Generic quantifier elimination, even after denominator clearing, also supplies no such delay bound.
